name: Kingfisher Villa Suites
positioning: An intimate villa-suite safari retreat in the Waterberg.
experience: Villa suites, considered interiors and a quieter lodge setting.
character: Botanical restraint: forest green, leaf gold, fine serif contrast and generous light space.
composition: A left-aligned full-colour mark, dark forest navigation, a finely framed photograph and a white booking card on the left. Wide, quiet editorial copy beneath the image.
photoStyle: Architecture and furnished outdoor living; clean daylight, no people.
headline: A quieter kind of safari
copy: Explore Kingfisher Villa Suites, where considered spaces meet the Waterberg bush.
photoCaption: Pool and lounge at Kingfisher Villa Suites

name: Kwafubesi Tented Safari Camp
positioning: An intimate tented safari camp in the Waterberg.
experience: Canvas, elevated tents and immersion in the bush.
character: Warm brown, canvas-coloured surfaces and expressive Playfair Display headings.
composition: A centred camp mark and warm canvas background. The photograph leads on the left with an offset booking panel on the right; softer corners and a broad camp introduction.
photoStyle: Canvas accommodation among trees; warm natural light, no people.
tone: Unhurried, close to nature and welcoming.
headline: Under canvas. Close to the wild.
copy: Discover the tented safari experience at Kwafubesi in the Waterberg.
photoCaption: Luxury tent at Kwafubesi Tented Safari Camp

name: Hoyo Hoyo Safari Lodge
positioning: A warm African-style lodge on the Mluwati River in Kruger National Park.
experience: Thatched rondavels, earthy interiors and a welcoming lodge atmosphere.
character: Burnt orange blocks, upright condensed headings and tactile earthy light surfaces, directly informed by the site.
composition: Compact asymmetric header; broad burnt-orange navigation; a strong vertical colour edge on the booking panel and a full-width warm welcome band under the image. Angular rather than softly rounded.
photoStyle: Recognisable thatched architecture and burnt-orange details; no people or invented cultural motifs.
tone: Warm, direct and welcoming; avoid invented translations or cultural claims.
headline: A warm welcome to the wild
copy: Thatched peaks and earthy colours meet the Kruger bush at Hoyo Hoyo Safari Lodge.
photoCaption: Thatched lodge exterior at Hoyo Hoyo

name: Hamiltons Tented Camp
positioning: A tradition of elegant tented safari in a private Kruger concession.
experience: Teak, raised timber walkways, tented suites and river outlooks.
character: Olive, parchment and fine editorial serif type; a restrained heritage register.
composition: A spacious centred masthead, light navigation with fine olive rules, a double-line photo frame and a right-hand booking column. Symmetrical, square-edged and editorial.
photoStyle: Furnished lodge spaces, timber and quiet hospitality details; no people.
tone: Composed and evocative, without invented historical claims.
headline: A fine tradition of safari
copy: Discover the elegance of Hamiltons Tented Camp in Kruger National Park.
photoCaption: Main lodge lounge at Hamiltons Tented Camp

name: Imbali Safari Lodge
positioning: A luxury lodge safari in a private Kruger concession.
experience: Suites, lodge living and wildlife in the Mluwati concession.
character: Ochre olive, tall display lettering and clean, confident photographic presentation.
composition: A centred lodge mark above ochre navigation; the image spans the home page, followed by a compact horizontal search panel and broad typographic introduction. A distinctly image-first arrival.
photoStyle: Lodge architecture with warm low-light atmosphere; no people.
headline: Your Kruger safari begins here
copy: Explore Imbali Safari Lodge and the wild spaces of the Mluwati concession.
photoCaption: Suite at night at Imbali Safari Lodge
